title: workflow_run.workflows matches the workflow's name field, not its filename
answers: approval rerun not triggering after rename
why does rerun.yml not run after a workflow file rename
which workflow name does workflow_run filter match
body:
Invariant: the `workflows:` list under `on.workflow_run` must contain the `name:` value of the triggering workflow, not its filename.
Enforcement: .github/workflows/rerun.yml (on.workflow_run.workflows: [trigger-rerun]) matches .github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml (top-level name: trigger-rerun).
What breaks: if the trigger's name: still says an old value (for example `rerun` after the file was renamed), the worker's filter never matches and approvals silently stop invoking the rerun worker; no error is raised.
Applies: any rename of an approval trigger or worker workflow file or its name: field; keep the file name, name: field and workflow_run.workflows in sync in the same commit.
applies: Any rename of an approval trigger or rerun worker workflow file or its name: field.
says: Approving a pull request rerun fails to start the automated worker workflow.
Rerun automation never launches after approving a failed build run.
Workflow approval triggers stop working silently following recent automation updates.
Ensure automated rerun tasks trigger properly when upstream build approvals are granted.
search: Under on.workflow_run, the workflows list must specify the triggering workflow's top-level name field rather than its filename. In .github/workflows/rerun.yml, on.workflow_run.workflows matches the name field in .github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml; renaming the file without updating name causes approvals to silently stop triggering the worker. When renaming an approval trigger or worker workflow, keep the filename, name field, and workflow_run.workflows synchronized in the same commit.
